title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: The city never loses its charm, and the nonstop spawning of new restaurants and arts spaces is a testament to its endless creativity.

title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: This elegant city blends old and new, from century-old cafes to a lively underground bar culture and a new culinary scene.

title: 36 Hours in East Tokyo
abstract: From boutiques blooming in abandoned spaces to new ramen shops taking root amid high-rises, Eastern Tokyo promises to leave visitors wide-eyed with wonder.

title: 36 Hours in Eastern Tokyo
abstract: In eastern Tokyo, you can find a world of diversions from glittering Ginza to Yanaka’s winding streets, all east of the palace.

title: 36 Hours in Cape Town
abstract: Cape Town is a singularly inviting place, wowing visitors with its art, architecture, wine and culinary offerings, not to mention its spectacular setting amid mountains and sea.

title: 36 Hours in Cape Town
abstract: A plan for this stunning city might include a 5K run (or walk), browsing farm markets, dinner at a wine estate and, no surprise, heading up Table Mountain (by cable car).

title: 36 Hours in San Francisco
abstract: In a city that’s constantly reinventing itself, San Francisco has endless offerings, from bowling in the Mission to diversions on the waterfront, not to mention creative restaurants and bars.

title: 36 Hours in San Francisco
abstract: Have a picnic at the updated Dolores Park, take in the Mission’s murals with a docent and relax with a burger by the bay.
